source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Errata rewriting [Guardians of the Machine](vsdata:ability/grey-knights.brotherhood-techmarine.guardians-of-the-machine). Whenever an enemy unit finishes a **[Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** while **engaged** with a friendly **GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE** unit and no more than 6″ from this unit, you may target this unit with **[Heroic Intervention](vsdata:ability/core.heroic-intervention)**, whatever other uses it has had this phase. That use:

- costs 1 CP less
- does not stop other units using **[Heroic Intervention](vsdata:ability/core.heroic-intervention)** this phase

typedMechanics.trigger: enemy charge ends engaged with nearby friendly Grey Knights Vehicle
typedMechanics.sharedUseRestriction: other-unit use allowed before and after in same phase
